<script>
    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles navigation, animations, progress, nav dots
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.touchStartY = 0;

            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupMouseWheel();
            this.setupProgressBar();
            this.setupNavDots();

            // Activate first slide immediately
            if (this.slides[0]) {
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }
        }

        /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const opts = {
                threshold: 0.5,
                rootMargin: '0px'
            };

            this.observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, opts);

            this.slides.forEach(slide => this.observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page up/down, home/end */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* Touch / swipe support */
        setupTouchNav() {
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                this.touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const delta = this.touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                    this.goToSlide(delta > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Mouse wheel navigation — throttled */
        setupMouseWheel() {
            let lastWheel = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                lastWheel = now;
                this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Navigate to a specific slide index */
        goToSlide(idx) {
            const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, this.totalSlides - 1));
            if (clamped === this.currentSlide) return;
            this.currentSlide = clamped;
            this.slides[clamped].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }

        /* Progress bar: width as percentage of slides seen */
        setupProgressBar() {
            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
        }

        updateProgressBar() {
            if (!this.progressBar) return;
            const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* Navigation dots: one dot per slide */
        setupNavDots() {
            const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
            if (!nav) return;

            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                nav.appendChild(btn);
            });
        }

        updateNavDots() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
            });
        }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
    });
</script>

<script>
    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles navigation, animations, progress, nav dots
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.touchStartY = 0;

            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupMouseWheel();
            this.setupProgressBar();
            this.setupNavDots();

            // Activate first slide immediately
            if (this.slides[0]) {
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }
        }

        /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const opts = {
                threshold: 0.5,
                rootMargin: '0px'
            };

            this.observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, opts);

            this.slides.forEach(slide => this.observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page up/down, home/end */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* Touch / swipe support */
        setupTouchNav() {
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                this.touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const delta = this.touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                    this.goToSlide(delta > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Mouse wheel navigation — throttled */
        setupMouseWheel() {
            let lastWheel = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                lastWheel = now;
                this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Navigate to a specific slide index */
        goToSlide(idx) {
            const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, this.totalSlides - 1));
            if (clamped === this.currentSlide) return;
            this.currentSlide = clamped;
            this.slides[clamped].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }

        /* Progress bar: width as percentage of slides seen */
        setupProgressBar() {
            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
        }

        updateProgressBar() {
            if (!this.progressBar) return;
            const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* Navigation dots: one dot per slide */
        setupNavDots() {
            const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
            if (!nav) return;

            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                nav.appendChild(btn);
            });
        }

        updateNavDots() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
            });
        }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
    });
</script>

</body>
</html>

            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        /* 2. Each slide = exact viewport height */
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* 3. Content container */
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        /* 4. ALL typography uses clamp() */
        :root {
            --title-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.125rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.875rem);
            --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        /* 5. Cards/containers */
        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        /* 6. Lists */
        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* 7. Grids */
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        /* 8. Images */
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Short viewports */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL THEME & BACKGROUND
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* Ambient grid background — subtle structural lines */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 48px 48px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* Gradient mesh background layers */
        .slide-bg-mesh {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* All content above background layers */
        .slide-content, .slide > *:not(.slide-bg-mesh):not(.slide-number):not(.progress-bar) {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-magenta));
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s var(--ease-in-out);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--glow-cyan);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            z-index: 100;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.7vw, 7px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.7vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out-expo);
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--glow-cyan);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER INDICATOR
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            right: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            z-index: 10;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           REVEAL ANIMATIONS
           Triggered by .visible class via Intersection Observer
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(28px);
            transition:
                opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition:
                opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition:
                opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal,
        .slide.visible .reveal-left,
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: none;
        }

        /* Stagger delays for sequential reveals */
        .stagger-1 { transition-delay: 0.08s; }
        .stagger-2 { transition-delay: 0.18s; }
        .stagger-3 { transition-delay: 0.28s; }
        .stagger-4 { transition-delay: 0.38s; }
        .stagger-5 { transition-delay: 0.48s; }
        .stagger-6 { transition-delay: 0.58s; }
        .stagger-7 { transition-delay: 0.68s; }

        /* ===========================================
           COMMON UI COMPONENTS
           =========================================== */

        /* Eyebrow label above headings */
        .eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
        }
        .eyebrow::before {
            content: '';
            display: inline-block;
            width: clamp(16px, 2vw, 28px);
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--glow-cyan);
        }

        /* Section heading */
        .slide-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        /* Accent highlight inline */
        .hl-cyan { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .hl-magenta { color: var(--accent-magenta); }
        .hl-amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .hl-green { color: var(--accent-green); }

        /* Glowing chip / badge */
        .chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            padding: 0.25em 0.7em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .chip-cyan {
            background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.12);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
        }
        .chip-magenta {
            background: rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.12);
            color: var(--accent-magenta);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.3);
        }
        .chip-amber {
            background: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.12);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.3);
        }
        .chip-green {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 157, 0.12);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 157, 0.3);
        }

        /* Card container */
        .glass-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--bg-card-border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        }

        /* Horizontal divider */
        .divider {
            width: 100%;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            opacity: 0.3;
            margin: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem) 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(9, 20, 40, 0.9) 0%, transparent 80%),
                var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: flex-end;
            padding-bottom: clamp(3rem, 7vh, 6rem);
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            justify-content: flex-end;
            padding-bottom: 0;
        }

        .title-slide .hero-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
            opacity: 0.85;
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.2vw, 3.6rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.08;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: 16ch;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 1.8vh, 1.6rem);
        }

        .title-slide h1 .accent-word {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            display: block;
        }

        .title-slide .tagline {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1.05rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 55ch;
            line-height: 1.55;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 1.8rem);
        }

        .title-slide .meta-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .title-slide .arxiv-link {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
            transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
        }

        /* Animated scan line on title slide */
        .scan-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            opacity: 0.4;
            animation: scanDown 8s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes scanDown {
            0%   { top: 0%; opacity: 0; }
            5%   { opacity: 0.4; }
            95%  { opacity: 0.4; }
            100% { top: 100%; opacity: 0; }
        }

        /* Pulsing corner accent */
        .corner-accent {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(1rem, 3vh, 2.5rem);
            right: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            width: clamp(60px, 8vw, 110px);
            height: clamp(60px, 8vw, 110px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .corner-accent::after {
            content: '';
            width: 60%;
            height: 60%;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3), transparent);
            animation: pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.7; }
            50% { transform: scale(1.25); opacity: 1; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — SUBSTITUTION THREAT
           =========================================== */
        .threat-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .threat-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .threat-item {
            background: rgba(10, 22, 45, 0.7);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem);
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            transition: border-color 0.3s;
        }
        .threat-item:hover { border-color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3); }

        .threat-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.25);
            line-height: 1;
            min-width: 1.5ch;
        }

        .threat-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }

        .threat-desc {
            font-size: clamp(0.62rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .hypothesis-box {
            margin-top: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vh, 1.2rem);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.04);
            border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
        }

        .hypothesis-text {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .hypothesis-text strong {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3 — BENCHMARK TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .benchmark-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .bench-table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .bench-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.78rem);
        }

        .bench-table thead {
            background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .bench-table th {
            padding: clamp(0.35rem, 0.7vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: left;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            font-size: clamp(0.52rem, 0.8vw, 0.72rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bench-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.28rem, 0.55vh, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-size: clamp(0.52rem, 0.82vw, 0.74rem);
        }

        .bench-table .model-name {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .bench-table .fp8-row td {
            background: rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.04);
            color: rgba(180, 160, 170, 0.9);
        }

        .bench-table .fp8-row .model-name {
            color: rgba(255, 140, 170, 0.85);
        }

        /* Within-error-bar value highlight */
        .within-err {
            color: var(--accent-amber);
        }

        .bench-note {
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.9vw, 0.76rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
        }
        .bench-note::before {
            content: '▶';
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            font-size: 0.7em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — TEMPERATURE SCALING
           =========================================== */
        .temp-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .temp-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.6fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .temp-points {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .temp-point {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.7em;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .temp-icon {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding-top: 0.1em;
            min-width: 2ch;
        }

        .temp-point-text {
            font-size: clamp(0.68rem, 1.1vw, 0.9rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .temp-point-text strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .temp-fig {
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.15);
            overflow: hidden;
            background: rgba(10, 22, 40, 0.5);
        }

        .temp-fig img {
            width: 100%;
            max-height: min(52vh, 380px);
            object-fit: contain;
            display: block;
        }

        .temp-fig-caption {
            padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.52rem, 0.8vw, 0.68rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.1);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — LOG PROB NONDETERMINISM
           =========================================== */
        .logprob-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 70%, rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .logprob-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .logprob-fig {
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.15);
            overflow: hidden;
            background: rgba(10, 22, 40, 0.5);
        }

        .logprob-fig img {
            width: 100%;
            max-height: min(52vh, 370px);
            object-fit: contain;
            display: block;
        }

        .logprob-fig-caption {
            padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.52rem, 0.8vw, 0.68rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.1);
        }

        .logprob-points {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .logprob-point {
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.1);
            background: rgba(255, 0, 110, 0.04);
        }

        .logprob-point-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.9vw, 0.74rem);
            color: var(--accent-magenta);
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .logprob-point-text {
            font-size: clamp(0.62rem, 1vw, 0.82rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — RANDOMIZED SUBSTITUTION
           =========================================== */
        .random-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 40%, rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.07) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .attack-diagram {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .attack-node {
            text-align: center;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
        }

        .attack-node.api-node {
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.25);
            background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.06);
        }
        .attack-node.real-node {

<script>
    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles navigation, animations, progress, nav dots
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.touchStartY = 0;

            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupMouseWheel();
            this.setupProgressBar();
            this.setupNavDots();

            // Activate first slide immediately
            if (this.slides[0]) {
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }
        }

        /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const opts = {
                threshold: 0.5,
                rootMargin: '0px'
            };

            this.observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, opts);

            this.slides.forEach(slide => this.observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page up/down, home/end */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* Touch / swipe support */
        setupTouchNav() {
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                this.touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const delta = this.touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                    this.goToSlide(delta > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Mouse wheel navigation — throttled */
        setupMouseWheel() {
            let lastWheel = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                lastWheel = now;
                this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Navigate to a specific slide index */
        goToSlide(idx) {
            const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, this.totalSlides - 1));
            if (clamped === this.currentSlide) return;
            this.currentSlide = clamped;
            this.slides[clamped].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }

        /* Progress bar: width as percentage of slides seen */
        setupProgressBar() {
            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
        }

        updateProgressBar() {
            if (!this.progressBar) return;
            const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* Navigation dots: one dot per slide */
        setupNavDots() {
            const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
            if (!nav) return;

            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                nav.appendChild(btn);
            });
        }

        updateNavDots() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
            });
        }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
    });
</script>

</body>
</html>
